Commit message:
retry the tcp server again after close and listen (#18238)

close() turns retries off, and a later listen() never turned them back on, so a ServerTCP instance that was closed and listened again no longer re-listened after an unexpected close. listen() now turns them back on. The close event of the earlier close() can arrive after that listen(); a retry is not armed, or does not listen, while the server is listening, which would throw ERR_SERVER_ALREADY_LISTEN from the retry timer.
